title: Contract System Support Analyst
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group \> Business Process Analysis
**General Summary:**

Identifies, develops, and implements process improvement initiatives or solutions designed to enhance data collection, system, and process performance. Creates scalable, efficient, and flexible business designs that balance people, process, and systems. Measures and reviews data and performance metrics on an ongoing basis to identify and resolve issues. Drives solution deployment across the organization including documentation and user training.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field.

OR
  

Associate's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or related field and 2\+ years of related business process analysis experience.
  

OR
  

High School Diploma or equivalent and 3\+ years of related business process analysis experience.  

Join our team to transform Qualcomm's Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) space by improving processes and systems, boosting operational efficiency, and driving innovation with AI and other advanced technologies. We aim to deliver effective solutions that integrate seamlessly with business operations while providing exceptional support and value to stakeholders globally.


In this dynamic role, you will become an expert in **Agiloft** , Qualcomm's CLM platform, and serve as a key member of the CLM Operations team. You will provide operational support, configuration assistance, testing, documentation, training, and data quality oversight to ensure the platform remains secure, reliable, and effective for users globally.


Working closely with business users, contract managers, system administrators, IT teams, and third\-party vendors, you will troubleshoot issues, validate enhancements, maintain documentation, develop training materials, execute testing activities, and support ongoing platform improvements. You will play an important role in ensuring high\-quality system data, adherence to established policies and security requirements, and a positive end\-user experience.


This role is part of Qualcomm’s global CLM team with members located in both Hyderabad and San Diego. Regular collaboration across time zones is required. Candidates should be comfortable participating in evening meetings approximately twice per week, with additional flexibility as needed to support project activities, production issues, training, testing, upgrades, and stakeholder engagement.


We are seeking a detail\-oriented, customer\-focused professional with experience supporting enterprise business systems such as Agiloft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar low\-code platforms. The ideal candidate communicates effectively with both technical and business users, takes ownership of assigned work, maintains high standards for quality and accuracy, and is committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence.  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Operations, or related field
* 2\+ years of Supply Chain, Information Technology, Operations, or related work experience
* 1\+ year of experience supporting, configuring, testing, or administering enterprise business applications such as Agiloft, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar low\-code platforms
* 1\+ year customer\-facing support experience
* 1\+ year of experience with data analysis, reporting, or data quality activities
* 1\+ year of experience working in a large matrixed organization
* Experience creating user documentation, training materials, knowledge articles, or support content
* Experience performing system testing, validation, QA, or user acceptance testing activities
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Comfortable working with global teams and supporting stakeholders across multiple time zones
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provides day\-to\-day operational support for Qualcomm's Contract Lifecycle Management platform
* Assesses, troubleshoots, and resolves end\-user issues, questions, and enhancement requests while meeting established service levels
* Performs configuration and administrative activities within Agiloft and other supported platforms following established governance processes
* Executes QA, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing activities for system enhancements, upgrades, and defect fixes
* Creates, maintains, and executes test scripts and test plans
* Develops and maintains user documentation, process guides, knowledge articles, training materials, and quick reference guides
* Delivers end\-user training and supports adoption of new features and functionality
* Performs data quality reviews and supports contract data cleanup and governance initiatives
* Helps ensure platform configurations, data, and operational processes comply with security, governance, and policy requirements
* Runs reports, performs data analysis, and supports business reporting needs
* Participates in system releases, upgrades, validation efforts, and production support activities
* Collaborates effectively with business stakeholders, contract managers, attorneys, IT teams, and external vendors
* Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardization, and process improvements
* Actively manages individual priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
* Seeks learning opportunities within the industry and explores, evaluates, and recommends new technologies and trends

**Level of Responsibility:**

* Works under close supervision.
* Responsible for own work. Decision\-making is limited.
* Requires strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively support users and collaborate with stakeholders.
* Works within established department objectives and operational processes.
* Errors typically impact timelines, data quality, user experience, or operational efficiency and may require additional effort to correct.
* Tasks range from routine system support and testing activities to more complex troubleshooting and operational analysis.
* Problem solving is typically focused on investigating issues, identifying root causes, validating solutions, and ensuring quality outcomes.

title: QA Engineer – Automation (Playwright / Selenium)
description:
**Job Title:** QA Engineer – Automation (Playwright / Selenium)  
**Location:** Visakhapatnam/Hyderabad \- Work from office (Hybrid)  
**Experience:** 6 – 10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Looking for immediate to 15 days joiner only

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a detail\-oriented QA Engineer with five or more years of experience in manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in web test automation using **Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript, OR Java with Selenium and BDD Cucumber**.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of web applications. This role requires close collaboration with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using **Playwright or Selenium**.
* Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks using **JavaScript/TypeScript or Java**, including **BDD frameworks with Cucumber** where applicable.
* Perform manual and automated functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Create and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution reports.
* Identify, document, track, retest, and verify software defects.
* Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot and resolve application issues.
* Participate in requirement analysis and provide feedback from a QA perspective.
* Perform API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Validate application and database data using SQL queries.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor automated test execution results, analyze failures, and report defects.
* Improve test automation coverage, framework stability, and execution efficiency.
* Perform cross\-browser and cross\-platform testing.
* Ensure applications meet defined quality standards before production release.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Required Skills**

* Five or more years of experience in software testing, including manual and automation testing.
* Strong hands\-on experience in web automation testing using **Playwright (JavaScript/TypeScript) OR Selenium (Java) with BDD Cucumber**.
* Experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks, including BDD\-based frameworks (Cucumber) for Selenium\-based candidates.
* Experience with Page Object Model or similar automation design patterns.
* Strong experience in functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Experience in test planning, test case design, execution, and defect management.
* Experience in API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git version control.
* Working knowledge of SQL for database validation.
* Understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps Pipelines.
* Familiarity with Node.js, npm, and Playwright Test Runner (for Playwright candidates).
* Familiarity with Maven/Gradle and TestNG/JUnit (for Selenium/Java candidates).
* Experience testing REST APIs and microservices.
* Knowledge of cross\-browser and cross\-platform testing.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6\.
* Exposure to security testing concepts or tools.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with Docker or containerized test environments is an added advantage.

Pay: Up to ₹1,700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Mention your current Notice period
* Mention your current and expected CTC?

Experience:

* Automation: 4 years (Required)
* Playwright: 2 years (Preferred)
* Selenium: 3 years (Preferred)
* java: 3 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Hyderabad, Telangana (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: IT Oracle Fusion Test Engineer
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** IT Oracle Fusion Test Engineer

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, regular, hybrid work arrangements

**The job**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IT Oracle Fusion Test Engineer to join our established Oracle CoE. This role will support the Finance organization in the successful delivery of both project initiatives and operational enhancements across the Oracle ecosystem.


As a key member of the Oracle CoE Testing team, you will contribute throughout the end\-to\-end project lifecycle, ensuring that solutions meet business, functional, and quality expectations before deployment. In addition to supporting testing activities, you will collaborate with the broader QA community to drive testing best practices, continuous improvement initiatives, and the overall maturity of quality assurance processes.

**Key responsibilities**

* Plan, design, execute, and support testing activities across Oracle Fusion Cloud applications.
* Perform comprehensive manual testing, including:


	+ Smoke Testing
	+ Sanity Testing
	+ Functional Testing
	+ System Integration Testing (SIT)
	+ Regression Testing
	+ Data Migration Testing
	+ User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Analyse business and functional requirements to develop effective test scenarios, test cases, and validation strategies.
* Execute end\-to\-end testing to ensure business processes function as designed across integrated Oracle applications.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management, execution tracking, defect management, and reporting.
* Manage end\-to\-end testing activities using Azure DevOps (ADO), including the creation, maintenance, execution, and tracking of test cases, test suites, and test plans to ensure complete test coverage and requirements traceability.
* Maintain testing governance and reporting within ADO by documenting test results, defects, risks, and quality metrics, while ensuring accurate linkage of requirements, test artefacts, defects, and deployment activities throughout the testing lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), defect lifecycle management, and requirements traceability.
* Identify, document, track, and manage defects through to resolution, collaborating closely with development and functional teams.
* Support release validation activities and provide quality sign\-off recommendations based on testing outcomes.
* Contribute to the development and adoption of QA standards, methodologies, and best practices.
* Participate in project planning, requirement reviews, risk assessments, and test strategy discussions.

**Essential requirements**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance.
* Strong functional testing experience with Oracle Fusion Applications.
* Proven ability to perform comprehensive end\-to\-end validation across Oracle Fusion business processes.
* Solid understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and defect management processes.
* Experience in requirement analysis, test planning, test case design, execution, and reporting.
* Proficiency in defect lifecycle management, including logging, prioritization, tracking, retesting, and closure.
* Strong knowledge of integration testing and validation across multiple business processes and systems.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

**Desired skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, project managers, and business users.
* Experience working within global teams comprising both onshore and offshore resources.
* Ability to provide accurate and proactive status reporting to project and management stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and committed to continuous learning and process improvement.
* Demonstrated passion for enhancing testing methodologies, quality standards, and overall solution quality.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* This positions the role as an Oracle Fusion functional tester who not only performs end\-to\-end testing but also owns test governance, documentation, traceability, and execution management through Azure DevOps, which is a key expectation in modern QA team for the Oracle CoE.

**IT at AVEVA**


Our global team of 300\+ IT professionals is responsible for the systems and platforms that keep AVEVA running. By empowering our colleagues and ensuring the smooth operation of the company, we help keep the business healthy and productivity high. We also provide key support for the transformation and modernisation efforts globally.


We pride ourselves on a collaborative, inclusive and authentic culture that provides a framework allowing for autonomy, whilst always being available for support and guidance. We respect the differences that each team member brings and seek to include those perspectives in our solutions for our business functions. The energy and sense of purpose is evident when talking to team members, you will feel part of something special from the first day you join.

title: Tech Lead - Testing & Quality Assurance P 4C
Senior Salesforce Tester
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting\-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self\-driven, hands\-on team member who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.



The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives.



The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Test Planning \& Strategy**


* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies.
* Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities.


**Functional \& Regression Testing**


* Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities.
* Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance\-related business processes.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations.
* Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes.
* Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments.


**Integration \& Data Testing**


* Test integrations with third\-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman.
* Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems.
* Support testing of end\-to\-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications.


**Compliance \& Security Testing**


* Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions.
* Perform role\-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification.
* Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements.
* Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems.


**Performance \& Automation Testing**


* Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites.
* Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance.
* Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities.


**Defect Tracking \& Collaboration**


* Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management tools.
* Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Best Practices**


* Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices.
* Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.
* Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 7\+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing.
* Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices.
* Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
* Experience using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management and defect\-tracking tools.
* Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore\-onshore delivery model.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release pipelines.
* Experience validating Snowflake, MDM, SAP, Veeva, IQVIA, MedPro, or other pharmaceutical data integrations.
* Basic Python skills for test utilities, data validation, or automation support.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery, risk\-based testing, and software quality practices in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations and HCP/HCO engagement processes.
* Experience with Data Cloud, AI\-enabled Salesforce capabilities, and advanced automation frameworks.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.
